_metadata.description: Dual-mount validation service, the agent-readable maturity assessment, and the Test Genie performance-phase provider contract.

requirements.title: Dual-mount validation service
requirements.description: The API mounts the native performance-health/v1 services PLUS the shared scenario-validation/v1 ScenarioValidationService so Test Genie can delegate the build-time (axis ①) and UI-browser Lighthouse (axis ③) signals through one contract.

validation.notes: Asserts both the native services and the shared ScenarioValidationService are served and route to the same engine.

requirements.title: Agent-readable maturity assessment
requirements.description: Responses carry stable finding codes, severity, evidence, location, remediation, current and next Performance Health local maturity, the blocking findings for the next level, and global semantic impact; every emitted finding code maps in .vrooli/maturity.json. Severity owns pass/fail.

validation.notes: Golden assessment asserts deterministic codes, current/next level transitions, and that every code has a maturity mapping.

requirements.title: Test Genie performance provider recognized
requirements.description: Test Genie's Performance phase is served by performance-health over scenario-validation/v1; the native test-genie perf runner is deleted (not shimmed); the default phase profile is byte-identical and the provider-contract scan recognizes the provider.

validation.notes: Asserts the provider responds to the shared contract for the build-time and Lighthouse signals expected by Test Genie's Performance phase.
